metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Cargo project under [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) and [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). The binary accepts `--input` and `--output`, supports both `inspect` and `render`, uses only the Rust standard library, and enforces LAS 1.4 structural rules for the public header, VLRs/EVLRs, CRS records, point formats `0..10`, waveform descriptors/point fields, and Extra Bytes metadata. Standard `LASF_Spec` and `LASF_Projection` records are parsed structurally and rejected when malformed or contradictory, rather than being silently treated as opaque.

Verification completed with `cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` and a basic end-to-end `render -> inspect` round-trip using a minimal LAS 1.4 sample dataset. I did not build a broader test suite beyond that runtime check.
